script_text: Aquarius and Capricorn — the most electric tension in the zodiac. Air meets Earth, creating friction neither sign can ignore. It should clash, yet the attraction is magnetic. Aquarius Venus in the 11th House craves freedom while Capricorn Mars in the 2nd House demands security. These opposing desires pull you together and tear you apart. Mercury in Aquarius squares Mercury in Capricorn, so you speak entirely different emotional languages. Money misunderstandings and commitment debates will flare this month. Saturn rules both signs, giving this bond a rare foundation. Yet Uranus in Gemini squares Saturn in Aries, injecting volatility that can destroy or strengthen you. Love prediction: Venus entering Cancer in late August activates your 7th House, triggering a profound emotional breakthrough. Career-wise, Jupiter aspects your 10th House in September, signaling a joint opportunity elevating both reputations. Stop fixing each other and honor differences as complementary strengths. Comment your partner's sign below!
